	# ----- The company war -----
	# A takeover before the war of return leaves the landing to the company
	# guard: landing contracts are shared, while the boards choose naval
	# escorts or mercenary reinforcements. Once the humanists have started
	# that war, the landing focuses are bypassed. Security and reconstruction
	# hold the returned south; stock mobilisation prepares the great war.
